audit.why: Whimsy is a flat 18s cooldown — worth stating directly since the entire matchup plan (per content wants[]/spikes[]) is baiting that specific 18s window before committing E.

Content win[] (Lulu x5, Poppy x1 at first item, Lulu again at 2+ items) matches the packet levelChart exactly and both agree with the 48.68% Poppy-losing winrate over 2046 games — Whimsy's on-demand disable and Wild Growth's peel dominate the aggregate. No contradiction.

spikes[] correctly identify the level-2 Whimsy-cancels-the-all-in spike, the level-6 R Wild Growth hard-peel, and the narrow first-item flank window before Lulu's polymorph/ult are both up — all grounded in real Lulu tools.
